description: Submits an advisory consultation request directly into the TWVS enterprise pipeline. Persists to Cloudflare D1 with fail-fast validation. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'submit_consultation_inquiry' on TWVS Advisory & Consulting (twvs.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'list_practice_areas' or 'get_partner_ecosystem' or 'check_consultation_slots' for their respective operations). Parameters: name (required), company (optional), email (required), phone (required), division (required), interest (required), message (required), preferred_date (optional), preferred_time (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Creates a live record/session in the backend database; no authentication required for public initiation; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

company.description: Institution or business name [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

division.description: Parameter 'division' (string). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

email.description: Business email address [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

interest.description: Key discipline (e.g. Capital Markets, ISO 20022, API Security, Restaurant Costing) [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

message.description: Specific project scope or advisory requirements [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

name.description: Full name of requesting executive or representative [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

phone.description: Direct contact telephone number [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

preferred_date.description: Preferred date (YYYY-MM-DD) [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

preferred_time.description: Preferred time window (e.g. 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM SAST) [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

name: submit_consultation_inquiry
title: Submit Consultation Inquiry
